_comment: ParamSizeFor hit cases over the curated quant_vram.json seed: every seed model's canonical parameter-size token. ParamSize is part of entity identity (the #size segment), so a wrong token here re-keys an entity.

mutation.description: pins a single-digit size token, distinguishing it from the 70b sibling
pins a third size under a different version, so size and version cannot be conflated

provenance.ref: quant_vram.json seed row for the dracarys2 community finetune

mutation.description: pins a namespaced community-finetune id, whose size must resolve like a first-party one
